## Reviewer's Guide The generic PostgreSQL durable-task enqueue now uses the ID returned by its UPSERT, preventing a concurrent losing caller from recording an event against its discarded speculative ID and triggering a foreign-key failure. Comprehensive real-PostgreSQL proofs cover the race, creator rollback, ordinary enqueue, all replacement states, and transactional rollback while confirming existing behavior remains unchanged. #### Sequence diagram for concurrent durable-task enqueue identity ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant A as Enqueue caller A participant DB as PostgreSQL participant B as Enqueue caller B participant E as Task event store A->>DB: execute _TASK_UPSERT_SQL with proposed_task_id_A DB-->>A: RETURNING id_A B->>DB: execute _TASK_UPSERT_SQL with proposed_task_id_B DB-->>B: RETURNING id_A A->>E: _record_event(id_A, 1, enqueued) B->>E: _record_event(id_A, 1, enqueued) B->>DB: execute _TASK_BY_ID_SQL with id_A DB-->>B: winning task row ``` #### Flow diagram for authoritative durable-task identity ```mermaid flowchart LR P[Speculative task ID] --> U[_TASK_UPSERT_SQL] U --> R[RETURNING id] R --> I[Authoritative task ID] I --> E[_record_event] I --> L[_TASK_BY_ID_SQL] E --> C[Event references retained task] L --> Q[Return queued task] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Use the database-returned task identity after the enqueue UPSERT for all subsequent operations. |
  • Add `RETURNING id` to the generic task UPSERT.
  • Replace speculative identity usage with the authoritative returned ID for enqueue events and task lookup.
  • Preserve existing generation, replacement, scheduling, wake, and transaction behavior.
| `backend/app/services/durable_tasks.py` | | Add real PostgreSQL regression proofs for concurrent identity resolution and unchanged enqueue durability semantics. |
  • Exercise concurrent first enqueues, including creator rollback and lock blocking, and verify events target the winning row.
  • Cover uncontended creation, replacement from all six task states, and rollback/retry history and metrics.
  • Register the five proofs in the existing durability execution path.
| `scripts/check_postgres_daily_study_dispatch.py` | | Document the issue, expected identity behavior, and regression coverage. |
  • Record the concurrent race and authoritative-ID contract in the regression catalog.
  • Document preservation of generation, replacement, payload, lease, retry, wake, and transaction semantics.
| `tests/REGRESSIONS.md` | ### Assessment against linked issues | Issue | Objective | Addressed | Explanation | | ------ | ------- | ----- | ----- | | https://github.com/aaweaver-actuary/tempo/issues/144 | Ensure concurrent first enqueues for the same task singleton use the authoritative persisted task ID selected by the UPSERT, so the losing transaction records events against the winning durable task instead of a nonexistent speculative ID. | ✅ | | | https://github.com/aaweaver-actuary/tempo/issues/144 | Preserve transaction atomicity and existing generation, lease, replacement, event, scheduling, wake, and rollback semantics while fixing the identity race. | ✅ | | | https://github.com/aaweaver-actuary/tempo/issues/144 | Add named deterministic real-PostgreSQL regression coverage for the concurrent first-enqueue race and register it in tests/REGRESSIONS.md. | ✅ | | ### Possibly linked issues - **#144**: PR #144 directly fixes the issue by using UPSERT RETURNING to record events against the authoritative winning task ID. ---

Especially useful if you want to start fresh with a new review - don't forget to comment `@sourcery-ai review` to trigger a new review! #### Customizing Your Experience Access your [dashboard](https://app.sourcery.ai) to: - Enable or disable review features such as the Sourcery-generated pull request summary, the reviewer's guide, and others. - Change the review language. - Add, remove or edit custom review instructions. - Adjust other review settings. #### Getting Help - [Contact our support team](mailto:support@sourcery.ai) for questions or feedback. - Visit our [documentation](https://docs.sourcery.ai) for detailed guides and information. - Keep in touch with the Sourcery team by following us on [X/Twitter](https://x.com/SourceryAI), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sourcery-ai/) or [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcery-ai).
